summary:
Main
The thirteenth consecutive night of American strikes closed out the week, and for the first time since this conflict began, the map grew. Yemen's Houthisstruck two Saudi oil tankers in the Red Sea and threatened a blockade of the Bab al-Mandab Strait, the route Saudi barrels had been taking around a shut Hormuz. Washington answered with threats of military punishment for further attacks on shipping and floated billing the damage to frozen Iranian assets, while both sides ruled out near-term talks.
